cluster.selected_from: qualitative clustering by editor across 1,343 ingested items

chosen.cluster: Zelensky fires top army commander Syrsky amid protests, names tech-minded Drapatyi in Ukraine's biggest wartime military shakeup
Yen breaches 163 to a fresh four-decade low against the dollar as BOJ signals faster rate-hike pace
Google unveils Gemini 3.6 Flash and cybersecurity AI while flagship 3.5 Pro slips, spooking investors ahead of Alphabet earnings
Hegseth tells Senate the Iran war has cost $37.5B as Trump threatens to hit Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site 'very heavily' on the 11th night of strikes
Trump plans 100 percent tariff on generic drugs after 2028, escalating to 200 percent, to force US pharma onshoring

select.notes: Composition: 4 core-beat (Markets, Tech, Politics, Business) plus 1 World lead qualifying via mandate escape hatch (Bloomberg + Economist mandate coverage of Ukraine military reshuffle).

research.supplementary_note: Reuters/AP/Ars Technica via Google News redirect URLs failed to resolve for slots 2, 3 and 5; supplementary body-tier coverage drawn from CNBC direct URLs (Yahoo/Politico mirror for slot 5) — all in sources.json body_fetchable except Politico, whose direct feed also returned HTTP 403.

edit.notes: Editor sub-agents skipped in favor of editor-in-chief manual verification pass. All quoted strings verified against dossier bodies via node grep with punctuation normalization; one over-specific city list in slot 1 lede corrected in-line.

errors: Politico, The Verge, FT Home RSS feeds returned HTTP 403 during ingest — no impact on final edition; Politico story reached via Yahoo mirror.

Google News RSS article redirects (news.google.com/rss/articles/...) require JavaScript to resolve to the underlying Reuters/AP/Ars Technica URL; WebFetch and curl both fail to follow them. Body content for slots 2 and 3 was retrieved from CNBC direct URLs on the same story.
